_note: Source: /workspace/tradersfundhub/research/closed-firms-evidence.md (captured 2026-10-20). Only firms that file recommends are listed. Quotes marked basis 'secondary' come from trade press, not the firm. Keep 'published' false until editorial sign-off; while false the page is noindex and left out of the sitemap.

firms.name: True Forex Funds
firms.dateLabel: Notice live by May 13, 2024 (the notice itself is undated)
firms.quote: We regret to inform you that True Forex Funds has ceased all operations and will be closing permanently due to financial insolvency.
firms.note: The firm's own site still showed the notice on October 20, 2026.

firms.name: Funded Engineer
firms.status: Closed (said it would file for bankruptcy)
firms.dateLabel: Notice live by July 19, 2024 (the notice itself is undated)
firms.quote: It is with deep regret and a heavy heart that we announce the permanent closure of Funded Engineer.
firms.note: The live domain is now parked; the archived copy shows the notice. We found no bankruptcy filing.

firms.name: SurgeTrader
firms.dateLabel: May 24, 2024 (the date given in its notice)
firms.quote: It is with deep regret that we announce that as of today, Friday, May 24, 2024, SurgeTrader has closed and ceased all operations.
firms.note: No archived copy of the firm's own notice exists. The wording is quoted from FX News Group; SurgeTrader's own post that day is a bare link.

firms.name: MyFundedFX (later SeacrestFunded)
firms.status: Rebranded February 2025; prop trading closed February 2026
firms.quote: Only the Prop arm of the operations is closing, the CFD Brokerage remains open.
firms.note: myfundedfx.com now redirects to seacrestmarkets.io/closed, which says Seacrest Markets is no longer operating (undated). The February 2025 rebrand date comes from trade press. MyFundedFutures is a separate brand and is still operating.

firms.name: The Funded Trader
firms.status: Offline since September–October 2026, no official statement
firms.dateLabel: Sites returning HTTP 402 since at least October 14, 2026
firms.note: That quote is the error both official domains returned on October 20, 2026. The firm has not said it is closed; the last archived copy (June 2026) shows it still selling challenges. We delisted it on October 14, 2026.
